s: Beat the eggs with the crème fraîche, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Melt half the butter in a skillet over medium heat and wilt the spinach for 2 minutes, then set aside.
Add the remaining butter to the pan, pour in the beaten eggs and cook 3 minutes over medium-low heat, drawing the edges toward the center.
Spread the spinach and Emmental over one half of the omelette, cover and cook 1 to 2 minutes until the cheese melts.
Fold the omelette in half, cut into two portions and serve right away.
l00-omelette-epinards-fromage.p: Swap the spinach for mushrooms or green peppers, depending on what you have in the fridge.

l00-muffins-oeufs-legumes.t: Egg, Bell Pepper and Cheese Muffins
s: Preheat the oven to 180°C and oil a 6-cup muffin tin.
Beat the eggs with the milk, salt and paprika.
Divide the bell pepper, spring onion and half the cheese among the bottom of the cups.
Pour the egg mixture into each cup until three-quarters full and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until the muffins are puffed and golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from the tin (2 muffins per person).
l00-muffins-oeufs-legumes.p: They keep 4 days in the refrigerator: reheat for 30 seconds in the microwave for a quick breakfast.

s: Mix the coconut milk, water, erythritol, cinnamon and vanilla in a bowl.
Add the chia seeds and whisk for 1 minute to prevent lumps.
Wait 5 minutes, then whisk again.
Divide between two glasses, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle with toasted flaked almonds.
l00-pudding-chia-coco.p: Prepare 4 glasses on Sunday evening: they keep for 3 days in the refrigerator.

i: cream cheese (such as Kiri or Philadelphia)
s: Melt the mozzarella and cream cheese in the microwave for 1 minute 30 seconds, stirring halfway through.
Add the almond flour, baking powder, salt and egg, then knead until you have a smooth dough.
Divide into 4 balls, oil them lightly and roll them out between two sheets of baking paper into thin squares.
Brush with melted butter, fold each square in thirds and then in thirds again to make a small layered square, and gently flatten it.
Cook in an oiled non-stick skillet over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until well browned.
Serve hot with a drizzle of melted butter or a soft fresh cheese.
l00-msemen-keto-amande.p: For a sweet version, serve with a homemade erythritol and butter syrup; for a savory one, stuff with spiced ground meat before folding.

s: Blend the eggs, cream cheese, almond flour, erythritol, baking powder and cinnamon until the batter is smooth.
Let the batter rest for 2 minutes so it thickens slightly.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat with a little butter.
Pour in small ladlefuls of batter and cook 2 minutes, until bubbles appear, then flip gently and cook 1 minute.
Serve hot with a little butter or a few raspberries.
l00-pancakes-fromage-frais.p: Make small pancakes (8 cm): without wheat flour they are fragile, and smaller ones are easier to flip.

l00-chakchouka-keto.t: Chakchouka with Eggs and Bell Peppers
s: Cut the bell pepper into strips, dice the tomato and thinly slice the onion and garlic.
Sauté the onion and bell pepper in the olive oil over medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and salt, stir for 1 minute, then add the tomato.
Simmer 7 minutes over low heat until the sauce thickens.
Make 4 wells in the sauce, crack the eggs into them, cover and cook 4 to 5 minutes until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with coriander and serve straight from the pan.
l00-chakchouka-keto.p: Stick to the amounts of tomato and onion given to stay under 8 g of carbs; add a pinch of harissa for extra kick.

s: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Halve the avocado, remove the pit and scoop out a little flesh to enlarge the cavity.
Wedge the avocado halves in a small dish (with crumpled aluminium foil) so they stay upright.
Crack an egg into each cavity, season with salt and pepper and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the white is set.
Sprinkle with paprika and chives before serving.
l00-avocat-oeuf-four.p: Keep the scooped-out flesh with a little lemon juice: use it for a quick guacamole as a snack.

l00-tajine-poulet-citron-olives.t: Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon and Olives
s: Mix the grated onion, garlic, oil, ginger, turmeric, saffron, salt and half the herbs; coat the chicken in this marinade for 15 minutes (or overnight in the refrigerator).
Place the chicken and marinade in a tagine or Dutch oven and brown for 5 minutes over medium heat, turning the pieces.
Add the water, cover and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes, basting from time to time.
Rinse the olives, cut the preserved lemon peel into strips (discard the pulp) and add them to the tagine.
Continue cooking, covered, for 15 minutes until the sauce is reduced and creamy.
Sprinkle with the remaining parsley and coriander and serve with cauliflower rice or a green salad, without bread.
l00-tajine-poulet-citron-olives.p: Olives and preserved lemon are salty: taste before adding salt at the end of cooking. The tagine is even better reheated the next day.

l00-tajine-kefta-oeufs.t: Kefta Tagine with Tomato and Eggs
s: Mix the meat with the onion, half the herbs, the cumin, paprika and half the salt, then shape about twenty small meatballs.
In a tagine or large skillet, heat the oil, add the crushed garlic and tomatoes, the remaining salt and the chili; cook 10 minutes over medium heat.
Place the meatballs in the sauce, cover and simmer 15 minutes, turning them halfway through.
Crack the eggs between the meatballs, cover and cook 5 minutes until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with the remaining herbs and serve piping hot.
l00-tajine-kefta-oeufs.p: Prepare a double batch of raw meatballs and freeze them flat: they cook straight in the sauce without thawing (add 5 minutes).

s: Peel the eggplants in alternating strips, cut into cubes and steam for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool them and peel.
In a skillet, sauté the crushed garlic in the olive oil for 1 minute, add the seeded, diced tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Add the eggplant, cumin, paprika and salt, then mash with a fork while stirring for 8 to 10 minutes until you have a thick purée.
Off the heat, add the lemon juice and herbs; let cool slightly.
Serve the zaalouk warm or cold with 2 hard-boiled eggs per person cut into wedges and a drizzle of olive oil.
l00-salade-zaalouk-oeufs.p: Zaalouk keeps 4 days in the refrigerator; also serve it alongside skewers or grilled fish.

s: Cut the chicken into strips, then season with salt and pepper.
Brown the chicken in the oil and half the butter over high heat for 6 to 7 minutes, then set aside.
In the same pan, melt the remaining butter and sauté the sliced mushrooms for 6 minutes until their water has evaporated.
Add the chopped garlic and thyme, cook 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and Parmesan, reduce 4 minutes over low heat, then return the chicken and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with green beans, spinach or cauliflower mash.
l00-poulet-creme-champignons.p: Boneless chicken thighs make a more tender dish that is richer in fat, ideal for keto.

i: can of tuna in olive oil, drained (160 g)
s: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, plunge them into cold water and peel.
Make the dressing by whisking the olive oil, lemon juice, mustard and salt.
Wash the lettuce, slice the cucumber and dice the avocado.
Arrange the lettuce on two plates, add the cucumber, avocado, flaked tuna and olives.
Add the eggs cut into wedges and drizzle with the dressing just before serving.
l00-salade-thon-avocat.p: To take to work: put the dressing in a small separate jar and sprinkle the avocado with lemon juice to keep it from browning.

s: Season the meat with the salt and cumin, then shape 4 patties 2 cm thick.
Cook the patties in a very hot skillet or on a grill for 3 to 4 minutes per side depending on how you like them cooked.
Place a slice of cheddar on each patty for the last minute and cover to melt it.
Mix the mayonnaise and mustard to make the sauce.
Wrap each patty in 2 or 3 large lettuce leaves with a slice of tomato, pickles and the sauce.
l00-burger-laitue-sans-pain.p: Replace the lettuce with two grilled portobello mushroom caps for a sturdier "bun".

l00-riz-chou-fleur-saute-poulet.t: Cauliflower Fried Rice with Chicken and Vegetables
s: Pulse the cauliflower in a food processor until it is the size of rice grains.
Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp of oil over high heat for 6 minutes, then set aside.
Beat the eggs, scramble them in the pan for 1 minute and set aside with the chicken.
Add the remaining oil, the garlic, ginger and diced zucchini, and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the cauliflower rice and stir-fry 5 minutes over high heat, stirring, uncovered so it stays firm.
Return the chicken and eggs, drizzle with soy sauce, sprinkle with spring onions and serve.
l00-riz-chou-fleur-saute-poulet.p: Raw cauliflower rice freezes very well in 250 g bags: make a big batch all at once.

i: tomato sauce with no added sugar
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Melt 200 g of mozzarella and the cream cheese in the microwave for 1 minute 30 seconds, stirring halfway.
Add the almond flour, egg and salt and knead quickly until you have a smooth ball.
Roll the dough between two sheets of baking paper into a 28 cm disc, remove the top sheet and prick with a fork.
Pre-bake the crust for 10 minutes until lightly golden.
Top with tomato sauce, mozzarella, mushrooms, olives and oregano.
Return to the oven for 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese bubbles; let rest 3 minutes before slicing.
l00-pizza-fathead.p: If the dough stiffens while kneading, microwave it for 10 seconds. Add chicken or tuna for a higher-protein version.

l00-courgettes-farcies-viande.t: Zucchini Stuffed with Ground Meat and Cheese
s: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Halve the zucchini lengthwise and scoop them out with a spoon, leaving a 1 cm border.
Chop the scooped-out flesh. Sauté the onion and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes, add the meat and cook 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the zucchini flesh, tomatoes, cumin, paprika and salt; cook 5 minutes until the liquid has evaporated.
Arrange the zucchini in a dish, fill with the stuffing and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until the zucchini are tender and the cheese is golden.
l00-courgettes-farcies-viande.p: Use the same stuffing with bell peppers or eggplants; it freezes for 2 months.

l00-saumon-beurre-citronne.t: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon Butter Sauce and Asparagus
s: Pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels, then season with salt and pepper.
Cook the asparagus 4 minutes in boiling salted water, drain and keep warm.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the salmon skin side down for 5 minutes without moving it, then turn and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove the salmon, lower the heat, add the butter and chopped garlic and let it foam for 1 minute.
Off the heat, add the lemon juice and herbs, whisking to emulsify the sauce.
Serve the salmon on the asparagus, topped with the lemon butter.
l00-saumon-beurre-citronne.p: Frozen salmon works very well: thaw it overnight in the refrigerator and dry it thoroughly before cooking for crispy skin.

l00-harira-keto.t: Keto Harira Without Legumes or Flour
i: lamb shoulder or beef, finely diced
s: In a large pot, sauté the meat, chopped onion, sliced celery and half the herbs in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the ginger, turmeric, pepper, saffron, salt and smen, then the puréed tomatoes and tomato paste; cook 5 minutes.
Pour in the water, cover and simmer 35 minutes over medium heat (or 20 minutes in a pressure cooker) until the meat is tender.
Add the cauliflower rice and the remaining herbs, cook 8 minutes.
For the "tedouira" (thickener), sprinkle in the xanthan gum in a fine rain while whisking vigorously for 1 minute until the soup thickens.
Beat the eggs and pour them in a thin stream into the simmering soup, stirring to form ribbons.
Serve piping hot with a lemon wedge; instead of dates, serve with a hard-boiled egg or a few olives.
l00-harira-keto.p: Cauliflower rice replaces the lentils and chickpeas, and xanthan gum replaces the flour: use an extra 1/2 tsp if you like a very thick harira. Freezes for 3 months.

s: Preheat the oven to 200°C and butter a baking dish.
Cook the cauliflower for 8 minutes in boiling salted water or steam it, then drain well and pat dry.
In a saucepan, heat the cream with the cream cheese, grated garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper until you have a smooth sauce.
Off the heat, stir in half the Emmental.
Arrange the cauliflower in the dish, cover with the sauce, and sprinkle with the remaining Emmental and the Parmesan.
Bake 20 minutes until the top is well browned.
l00-gratin-chou-fleur.p: Add 200 g of diced cooked chicken or tuna to make it a complete meal.

l00-veloute-brocoli-cheddar.t: Cream of Broccoli Soup with Cheddar
s: Melt the butter in a saucepan and sauté the chopped onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the broccoli and stock, bring to a boil, then cook 12 minutes over medium heat.
Blend the soup until smooth, setting aside a few small florets for garnish if you like.
Return to low heat, add the cream, then the cheddar little by little, stirring until it melts, without letting it boil.
Adjust the seasoning and serve hot, sprinkled with pumpkin seeds dry-toasted for 2 minutes in a skillet.
l00-veloute-brocoli-cheddar.p: Frozen broccoli works perfectly; add diced fresh cheese or toasted seeds at serving for crunch.

i: green bell pepper, cut into squares
s: Make the chermoula by blending or mixing the oil, herbs, crushed garlic, cumin, paprika, chili, lemon and salt.
Cut the chicken into 3 cm cubes and coat in the chermoula; marinate at least 1 hour in the refrigerator (ideally overnight).
Thread the chicken cubes onto skewers, alternating with the bell pepper squares.
Cook on a grill, barbecue or very hot plancha for 12 to 15 minutes, turning regularly.
Serve with a Moroccan cucumber-tomato salad or zaalouk.
l00-brochettes-poulet-chermoula.p: Chermoula keeps 5 days in the refrigerator in a jar covered with oil: it is also great for fish and shrimp.

l00-crevettes-ail-persil.t: Sautéed Shrimp with Garlic, Parsley and Chili
s: Pat the shrimp dry with paper towels and salt lightly.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add the garlic and chili and let infuse for 1 minute without browning.
Increase the heat, add the shrimp and paprika and cook 2 minutes per side until pink.
Add the butter, lemon juice and parsley, stir for 30 seconds.
Sauté the zucchini noodles for 2 minutes in the remaining sauce and serve with the shrimp.
l00-crevettes-ail-persil.p: For a dairy-free version, replace the butter with an extra 1 tbsp of olive oil.

l00-curry-poulet-coco.t: Chicken Curry with Coconut Milk and Spinach
s: Cut the chicken into pieces and brown in the oil for 5 minutes over high heat, then set aside.
Sauté the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes, add the curry powder and turmeric and cook 1 minute to release the aromas.
Pour in the coconut milk, return the chicken, add salt and simmer 15 minutes over low heat.
Add the spinach and cook 2 minutes until wilted.
Sprinkle with coriander and serve with cauliflower rice.
l00-curry-poulet-coco.p: The curry tastes even better the next day; it freezes for 3 months in individual portions.

s: Slice the zucchini lengthwise into thin strips (3 mm), salt them and let them drain for 15 minutes on paper towels, then pat dry.
Sauté the garlic in the oil, add the meat and cook 6 minutes, then the tomatoes, tomato paste, oregano and salt; simmer 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 190°C. Mix the ricotta, egg and half the Parmesan.
In a dish, alternate a layer of zucchini, bolognese, ricotta mixture and mozzarella; repeat 2 times.
Finish with the mozzarella and the remaining Parmesan.
Bake 35 minutes, then let rest 10 minutes before cutting so the slices hold together.
l00-lasagnes-courgettes.p: Draining the zucchini is essential to avoid a watery lasagna. Roast the strips for 5 minutes in the oven for even better hold.

l00-poisson-four-tomates-olives.t: Baked Fish Fillets with Cherry Tomatoes and Olives
i: whiting, pollock or sea bream fillets
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Mix the olive oil, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt and half the parsley.
Arrange the fillets in a dish and brush with this mixture.
Scatter the cherry tomatoes, olives and lemon slices around them.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes depending on the thickness of the fillets, until the flesh flakes easily.
Sprinkle with the remaining parsley and serve with a green salad or green beans.
l00-poisson-four-tomates-olives.p: Ask your fishmonger for the catch of the day; sardines or John Dory also work very well.

s: Melt the coconut oil over very low heat or for 30 seconds in the microwave.
Add the almond butter, cocoa, erythritol, vanilla and salt, and whisk until smooth.
Fold in the shredded coconut.
Divide among 12 cavities of a silicone mold or mini muffin liners.
Freeze for 30 minutes until firm, then unmold.
l00-bombes-graisse-coco-chocolat.p: Store them in the refrigerator or freezer (they melt quickly above 24°C, especially in summer in Morocco).

s: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with baking paper.
Place small mounds of grated cheese (1 tbsp each) 4 cm apart.
Sprinkle with paprika, oregano and nigella seeds.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes until the edges are golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet: the chips harden as they cool.
l00-chips-fromage-four.p: They keep 3 days in an airtight container; perfect with guacamole or zaalouk.

l00-oeufs-mimosa.t: Deviled Eggs with Mustard and Paprika
s: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then plunge them into ice water for 5 minutes.
Peel the eggs and halve them lengthwise.
Remove the yolks and mash them with a fork with the mayonnaise, mustard and salt.
Fill the whites with this mixture using a spoon or piping bag.
Sprinkle with paprika and chives and refrigerate until serving.
l00-oeufs-mimosa.p: Add a little flaked tuna to the filling for a more filling snack.

l00-amandes-grillees-epices.t: Roasted Almonds with Cumin and Paprika
s: Preheat the oven to 170°C.
Toss the almonds with the olive oil, then with the cumin, paprika, salt and chili.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with baking paper.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden and fragrant.
Let cool completely so they become crunchy.
l00-amandes-grillees-epices.p: One serving = 30 g (a small handful): prepare small bags so you don't end up eating the whole jar.

l00-crackers-graines.t: Flax, Sesame and Sunflower Seed Crackers
s: Mix all the seeds with the water, oil and salt, then let rest 15 minutes until the mixture gels.
Preheat the oven to 160°C.
Spread the dough thinly (3 mm) on a baking sheet lined with baking paper and pre-cut squares with a knife.
Bake 30 minutes, turn the sheet of crackers around and continue 15 minutes until dry and golden.
Let cool completely in the switched-off oven with the door ajar, then break along the lines.
l00-crackers-graines.p: Keep them 2 weeks in an airtight container; if they soften, put them back in the oven for 5 minutes at 150°C.

l00-bouchees-concombre-saumon.t: Cucumber Bites with Cream Cheese and Smoked Salmon
s: Wash the cucumber and cut it into 1 cm thick slices.
Mix the cream cheese with the lemon juice, dill and pepper.
Place a small spoonful of cheese on each slice.
Cut the smoked salmon into strips and place one on each bite.
Refrigerate for 10 minutes before serving.
l00-bouchees-concombre-saumon.p: Replace the smoked salmon with flaked tuna or chopped olives for a more budget-friendly version.

i: very cold full-fat liquid cream (30% fat)
s: Melt the chocolate and butter in a double boiler over low heat, then let cool for 5 minutes.
Whip the very cold cream with the erythritol and vanilla until it forms stiff peaks.
Fold one spoonful of whipped cream into the chocolate to loosen it, then gently fold in the rest with a spatula.
Divide among 4 ramekins and dust with cocoa.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.
l00-mousse-chocolat-noir.p: Blitz the erythritol to a fine powder before using: it dissolves better and avoids a "crunchy" effect.

l00-cheesecake-leger-keto.t: Light Lemon Cheesecake on an Almond Base
s: Preheat the oven to 170°C. Mix the almond flour, melted butter and 1 tbsp of erythritol, then press into the bottom of a lined 20 cm pan.
Pre-bake the base for 10 minutes and let cool slightly; lower the oven to 150°C.
Whisk the cream cheese with the erythritol until smooth, then add the cream, zest, lemon juice and vanilla.
Add the eggs one at a time on low speed, without over-whisking to avoid bubbles.
Pour over the base and bake 40 minutes: the center should still jiggle slightly.
Let cool in the switched-off oven with the door ajar for 1 hour, then refrigerate at least 6 hours.
l00-cheesecake-leger-keto.p: Place a dish of hot water on the bottom of the oven while baking to keep the cheesecake from cracking.

s: In a large mug, mix the almond flour, cocoa, erythritol and baking powder.
Add the egg and melted butter and whisk with a fork until smooth.
Push the square of chocolate into the center of the batter.
Microwave 70 to 90 seconds on full power (800 W): the top should be set but still soft.
Let rest for 1 minute before enjoying.
l00-mug-cake-chocolat.p: Serve with a spoonful of thick crème fraîche or unsweetened whipped cream for extra indulgence.

l00-panna-cotta-vanille-framboises.t: Vanilla Panna Cotta with Raspberry Coulis
s: In a saucepan, mix the cream, 2 tbsp of erythritol, vanilla and agar-agar.
Bring to a boil while whisking, then boil for 2 minutes to activate the agar-agar.
Divide among 4 glasses and let cool, then refrigerate 2 hours.
For the coulis, heat the raspberries with the remaining erythritol and the lemon juice for 3 minutes, then crush and strain if desired.
Top the panna cottas with the cold coulis just before serving.
l00-panna-cotta-vanille-framboises.p: Agar-agar replaces animal gelatin for a 100% halal recipe; measure carefully (2 g per 400 ml) for a wobbly texture.

s: Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a baking sheet with baking paper.
Mix the almond flour, erythritol, baking powder, cinnamon and lemon zest.
Add the egg, coconut oil and orange blossom water and knead until you have a soft dough.
Shape 12 walnut-sized balls, roll them in the powdered erythritol and flatten them slightly on the sheet.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the ghribas crack and turn lightly golden.
Let cool completely on the sheet before handling; they are fragile when hot.
l00-ghriba-keto-amandes.p: Perfect with sugar-free mint tea (sweetened with stevia); they keep for a week in an airtight container.

l00-porridge-lin-coco-noix.t: Warm Flax, Coconut and Walnut Porridge
s: In a small saucepan, mix the flax seeds, coconut, chia seeds, cinnamon and erythritol.
Pour in the almond milk and cream, then heat over medium heat, stirring constantly.
At the first bubbles, lower the heat and cook 3 to 4 minutes until you have a thick porridge texture.
Off the heat, let rest 1 minute: the mixture keeps thickening. Loosen with a little almond milk if needed.
Divide between two bowls, top with chopped walnuts and raspberries, and serve warm.
l00-porridge-lin-coco-noix.p: Prepare the dry mix (flax, coconut, chia, cinnamon) for the week in a jar: in the morning, you only need to add the liquid.

s: Mash the jben with a fork in a large bowl, then add the eggs and mix until creamy and smooth.
Stir in the almond flour, Parmesan, herbs, cumin and salt. The batter should be thick; let rest 5 minutes.
Heat half the oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Drop in 3 large spoonfuls of batter, flatten into patties about 1 cm thick and cook 3 minutes until the underside is well browned.
Flip gently with a thin spatula and cook another 2 to 3 minutes. Repeat with the remaining oil and batter.
Serve warm, 3 patties per person, with a few olives and a glass of unsweetened tea.
l00-galettes-jben-herbes.p: If your jben is very moist, let it drain 30 minutes in a colander: the patties will hold together better when cooking.

l00-kefta-sardines-sauce-tomate.t: Sardine Meatballs in Spicy Tomato Sauce
s: Finely chop the sardine fillets with a knife or grinder, then mix them with half the garlic, coriander, parsley and spices, the lemon juice, the almond flour and half the salt.
With wet hands, shape walnut-sized balls (about 24) and chill for 10 minutes.
In a deep skillet or tagine, heat the olive oil and sauté the remaining garlic for 1 minute over medium heat.
Add the crushed tomatoes, the remaining spices, salt and the water; simmer 10 minutes uncovered.
Gently place the meatballs in the sauce, add the whole chili, cover and cook 12 minutes over low heat without stirring.
Gently shake the pan to coat the meatballs, sprinkle with the remaining herbs and serve hot.
l00-kefta-sardines-sauce-tomate.p: Ask the fishmonger to fillet the fish. Raw meatballs freeze very well on a tray before being put in bags.

l00-poke-saumon-konjac.t: Salmon Poke Bowl with Konjac Rice
s: Rinse the konjac rice under cold water for 1 minute, plunge it into boiling water for 2 minutes, drain, then dry it for 2 to 3 minutes in a hot skillet with no fat.
Mix the soy sauce, oil, vinegar and grated ginger to make the sauce.
Cut the salmon into 2 cm cubes and toss with half the sauce; set aside for 10 minutes in the refrigerator.
Dice the avocado and cucumber, slice the spring onion and cut the nori sheet into thin strips with scissors.
Divide the konjac rice between two bowls and arrange the salmon, avocado, cucumber and red cabbage in sections.
Drizzle with the remaining sauce, sprinkle with sesame, spring onion and nori, then serve right away.
l00-poke-saumon-konjac.p: If raw salmon is not suitable (children, pregnancy), sear the cubes in a skillet for 1 minute on each side before putting them in the bowl.

l00-tanjia-agneau-cumin.t: Lamb Tanjia with Cumin and Preserved Lemon
i: kg lamb shoulder, in large pieces
s: In a large bowl, mix the lamb with the cumin, saffron, salt, pepper, oil and smen to coat each piece well.
Place the meat in a cast-iron pot (or a tanjia jar), add the whole garlic cloves and the preserved lemon quarters.
Pour in the water and seal tightly (parchment paper under the lid for a pot).
Bake at 150°C for 3 hours without opening.
Take out the pot: the meat should fall apart with a fork. If the sauce is too thin, reduce it for 5 minutes over high heat without the lid.
Mash the confit garlic cloves into the sauce, sprinkle with parsley and serve with a cucumber salad.
l00-tanjia-agneau-cumin.p: Even better the next day: keeps 4 days in the refrigerator and freezes in portions with its sauce.

l00-cabillaud-fenouil-gratine.t: Cod Gratin on a Bed of Tender Fennel
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Thinly slice the fennel, keeping the fronds for the end.
Melt half the butter with the oil in a skillet, add the fennel and crushed garlic, salt and cook 10 minutes over medium heat until tender and lightly golden.
Spread the fennel in a baking dish and place the cod pieces on top. Season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with lemon juice.
Coat the fish with crème fraîche. Mix the Parmesan, almond flour and the remaining butter in small pieces with your fingertips, then sprinkle over the top.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, until the fish flakes and the top is golden.
Sprinkle with dill and chopped fennel fronds before serving.
l00-cabillaud-fenouil-gratine.p: Frozen cod works: thaw it the day before in the refrigerator and pat it dry thoroughly to avoid a watery gratin.

l00-halloumi-grille-chou-rouge-noix.t: Grilled Halloumi with Red Cabbage and Walnut Salad
s: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool them in cold water, peel and cut into wedges.
Mix the red cabbage with a pinch of salt, the vinegar, mustard and 2 tbsp of oil; massage for 1 minute with your hands to soften it.
Dry-toast the walnuts for 3 minutes in a skillet, then chop them roughly.
Cut the halloumi into 1 cm slices and pat dry. Heat the remaining oil in the skillet over high heat and brown the slices for 2 minutes on each side.
Divide the arugula and red cabbage among the plates, add the eggs and the hot halloumi.
Sprinkle with walnuts and mint, add pepper and serve immediately, as the halloumi should stay hot.
l00-halloumi-grille-chou-rouge-noix.p: The dressed red cabbage keeps 3 days in the refrigerator: make double for the week's lunches.

s: Grill the whole peppers under the oven broiler at 250°C (or directly over a flame) for 15 minutes, turning them, until the skin blackens.
Enclose them for 10 minutes in a bag or covered bowl, then peel, seed and cut into thin strips.
Peel and seed the tomatoes, then cut into small dice.
Heat the oil in a skillet, add the crushed garlic and tomatoes and cook 8 minutes over medium heat until they break down.
Add the peppers, spices and salt, then cook 7 minutes, lightly mashing, until the mixture is confit and the oil rises to the surface.
Off the heat, add the herbs. Serve warm or cold with grilled meats or eggs.
l00-taktouka-poivrons-grilles.p: Keeps 5 days in the refrigerator covered with a film of olive oil; it is even better the next day.

l00-puree-celeri-chou-fleur-beurre-noise.t: Celeriac and Cauliflower Mash with Brown Butter
s: Cut the celeriac into 2 cm cubes and place in a saucepan of cold salted water.
Bring to a boil, cook 8 minutes, then add the cauliflower and continue 10 to 12 minutes until everything is very tender.
Drain thoroughly and let steam for 3 minutes in the colander to release moisture.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat and cook 2 to 3 minutes until golden and nutty-smelling.
Blend the vegetables with the cream, Parmesan, nutmeg and half the brown butter until you have a smooth mash.
Serve drizzled with the remaining brown butter and sprinkled with chives.
l00-puree-celeri-chou-fleur-beurre-noise.p: Perfect alongside a steak or roast chicken; reheat in the microwave with a spoonful of cream.

l00-haricots-verts-amandes-citron-confit.t: Sautéed Green Beans with Almonds and Preserved Lemon
s: Cook the green beans for 6 minutes in a large pot of boiling salted water, then plunge into ice water to set their color and drain.
Rinse the preserved lemon peel, remove the pulp and cut into very thin sticks.
In a large skillet, dry-toast the flaked almonds for 2 minutes, stirring, then set aside.
Heat the butter and oil, add the garlic and preserved lemon and cook 1 minute without browning.
Add the beans and sauté 3 minutes over high heat. Add pepper and adjust the salt (preserved lemon is already salty).
Serve sprinkled with toasted almonds and parsley.
l00-haricots-verts-amandes-citron-confit.p: Blanched beans keep 3 days in the refrigerator: you only need to sauté them at the last minute.

i: eggs (1 for the dough, 1 for the glaze)
s: Melt the mozzarella and cream cheese in the microwave for 1 minute 30 seconds in two rounds, stirring, until smooth.
Stir in the almond flour and 1 egg, knead quickly until you have a smooth ball. Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Mix the mashed jben with the mint, cumin and salt for the filling.
Roll the dough thinly (3 mm) between two sheets of parchment paper and cut into 12 squares of about 8 cm.
Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each square, fold into a triangle and seal the edges with a fork.
Arrange on a lined baking sheet, brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame and bake 12 to 15 minutes until well browned.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving (2 briouates per person).
l00-briouates-fathead-jben.p: If the dough sticks while rolling, put it back in the refrigerator for 10 minutes. Cooked briouates reheat in 5 minutes in the oven.

l00-sellou-keto.t: Keto Sellou with Almonds and Sesame
s: Dry-toast the almond flour in a large skillet over low heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring constantly, until blond and fragrant. Set aside in a bowl.
Dry-toast the sesame seeds for 4 minutes, then the almonds for 6 minutes in an oven at 180°C; let cool.
Grind the almonds to a coarse powder, then the sesame (keeping 2 tbsp whole for decoration).
In the bowl, mix the toasted flour, almonds, sesame, flax seeds, erythritol, spices and salt.
Melt the butter and work it in little by little, rubbing the mixture between your hands until you have damp sand that holds together when pressed.
Mound into a dome on a plate, press down lightly, decorate with almonds and sesame and serve by the spoonful (about 2 tbsp per person).
l00-sellou-keto.p: Keeps 3 weeks in an airtight container away from heat; ideal to prepare before Ramadan.

l00-smoothie-avocat-cacao.t: Creamy Avocado, Cocoa and Almond Milk Smoothie
s: Halve the avocado, remove the pit and scoop out the flesh with a spoon.
Put all the ingredients in the blender jar, adding the ice cubes last.
Blend 45 seconds on full power until perfectly smooth.
Taste and adjust the sweetness, or loosen with a little almond milk if the smoothie is too thick.
Pour into two tall glasses and serve right away.
l00-smoothie-avocat-cacao.p: For a more filling breakfast, add 20 g of plain whey or 1 tbsp of chia seeds.

s: Make the coffee ahead of time and let it cool completely (at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator).
Shake the can of coconut milk well before opening to mix the cream and the liquid.
Put the coffee, coconut milk, erythritol, cinnamon, vanilla and half the ice cubes in a blender.
Blend 30 seconds until frothy.
Divide the remaining ice cubes between two glasses, pour in the iced coffee and sprinkle with a pinch of cinnamon.
l00-cafe-frappe-coco-cannelle.p: Freeze coffee in an ice cube tray: your ice cubes will no longer dilute the drink.

l01-omelette-roulee-saumon-fume.t: Smoked Salmon and Chive Rolled Omelette
s: Beat the eggs with the liquid cream, a small pinch of salt and pepper until evenly combined and slightly frothy.
Melt the butter in a large non-stick skillet (26–28 cm) over medium-low heat.
Pour in the eggs and tilt the pan to form a thin layer. Cook 3–4 minutes without stirring, until the top is almost set.
Cover for 1 minute off the heat to finish cooking, then slide the omelette onto a board.
Spread with cream cheese, sprinkle with chives and arrange the smoked salmon slices.
Roll the omelette up tightly, cut into 3 cm pieces and serve right away.
l01-omelette-roulee-saumon-fume.p: Prepare the roll the day before, wrap it tightly in plastic film and keep it in the refrigerator: it slices even more cleanly and can be eaten cold.

s: Mix the kefta with half the chopped coriander and parsley, the cumin, paprika, salt and pepper. Shape into small hazelnut-sized balls.
Heat the oil in a 24 cm skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the meatballs and brown 5–6 minutes, turning regularly.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pour them over the meatballs.
Lower the heat, cover and cook 3–4 minutes until the eggs are just set.
Sprinkle with the remaining herbs and serve straight from the pan.
l01-omelette-kefta-coriandre.p: Prepare the meatballs ahead and freeze them raw and flat: add them straight to the pan in the morning, cooking 2 minutes longer.

s: Separate the whites from the yolks. Beat the yolks with salt and pepper.
Whip the whites to stiff peaks with a pinch of salt, then gently fold them into the yolks with a spatula, lifting the mixture.
Melt the butter in a 24 cm skillet over low heat, pour in the mixture and smooth the surface.
Cover and cook 5–6 minutes over low heat, until the bottom is golden and the omelette has puffed up.
Sprinkle the cheddar over one half, cover for another minute to melt it.
Fold the omelette in half, sprinkle with chives and serve immediately before it deflates.
l01-omelette-soufflee-cheddar.p: For a well-set top, put the pan (if ovenproof) under the broiler for 2 minutes before folding.

l01-omelette-champignons-chevre.t: Pan-Fried Mushroom and Goat Cheese Omelette
s: Melt half the butter in a skillet over high heat. Add the mushrooms and let them brown 5 minutes without stirring too much, until their water has evaporated.
Add the garlic and parsley, season with salt and pepper, sauté 1 minute, then set aside on a plate.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Melt the remaining butter in the skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and draw the edges toward the center with a spatula for 2 minutes, until almost set.
Fill one half with mushrooms and crumbled goat cheese, fold over and leave 1 minute to melt the cheese.
Cut in half and serve hot.
l01-omelette-champignons-chevre.p: Add a handful of spinach with the garlic for a greener version, or replace the goat cheese with jben.

l01-oeufs-brouilles-cremeux-ciboulette.t: Creamy Scrambled Eggs with Butter and Chives
s: Crack the eggs into a small cold saucepan and add half the diced butter. Don't add salt yet.
Place over medium-low heat and stir constantly with a spatula, scraping the bottom and sides.
Every 30 seconds, take the pan off the heat for 10 seconds while continuing to stir, to keep a creamy texture (4–5 minutes in total).
When the eggs are almost set but still glossy, off the heat, stir in the remaining butter and the crème fraîche: this stops the cooking.
Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with chives and serve right away.
l01-oeufs-brouilles-cremeux-ciboulette.p: The secret is never to let the eggs stick: low heat, patience and a spatula in constant motion.

l01-oeufs-brouilles-tomate-cumin.t: Beldi-Style Scrambled Eggs with Tomato and Cumin
s: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the garlic for 30 seconds without browning.
Add the grated tomato, cumin, paprika and a pinch of salt. Reduce 4–5 minutes until you have a thick sauce.
Lightly beat the eggs and pour them over the sauce.
Stir gently with a spatula for 2–3 minutes over low heat, until the eggs are set in large, soft curds.
Sprinkle with coriander, add pepper and serve with a drizzle of olive oil.
l01-oeufs-brouilles-tomate-cumin.p: Grating the tomato (skin side toward your hand) gives a skinless pulp that reduces quickly.

l01-oeufs-brouilles-jben-menthe.t: Scrambled Eggs with Jben and Mint
s: Beat the eggs with a small pinch of salt (jben is already salty) and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-low heat and pour in the eggs.
Stir gently with a spatula for 2 minutes, until the eggs begin to set.
Add the crumbled jben and stir another minute: it should warm and soften without melting completely.
Sprinkle with fresh mint and serve with the black olives.
l01-oeufs-brouilles-jben-menthe.p: Without jben, use crumbled feta, reducing the salt even further.

l01-oeufs-brouilles-saumon-aneth.t: Scrambled Eggs with Smoked Salmon and Dill
s: Beat the eggs with the crème fraîche and pepper. Don't add salt: the salmon provides the salt.
Melt the butter in a non-stick skillet over low heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula for 3–4 minutes, until creamy.
Off the heat, add the smoked salmon and dill, and mix gently.
Sprinkle with a few drops of lemon and serve without waiting.
l01-oeufs-brouilles-saumon-aneth.p: Salmon added off the heat stays tender and doesn't dry out.
